# Note templates

[[Home]] | [[docs/knowledge/Documentation Workflow#Using templates|Using templates]]

- [[docs/templates/Decision Template]]

Use the core Templates command on a new note. Keep the template itself intact.
Resolve prompts into evidence-backed content and add the new note to its category
index. Empty templates are not completed documentation or verified observations.
